text: KCUR/NPR•October 13, 2026In race for Kansas governor, Masterson and Holscher focus on taxes and education fundingHolscher is emphasizing public education and other populist policies she argues have broad support among Kansans. That also includes recreational marijuana legalization and a focus on cutting property taxes. “Those are all things supported by at least 65 percent of the population of Kansas,” she said. “Those are things that I stand with the people on.”

Kansas Reflector•October 12, 2026Cindy Holscher, Ty Masterson gain gubernatorial endorsements from labor, ag interestsHolscher, elected to the Legislature nearly a decade ago, has been endorsed by Kelly and former Democratic Govs. Kathleen Sebelius and John Carlin. Her campaign has been backed by the Kansas AFL-CIO, Kansas National Education Association’s PAC, the American Federation of Teachers, the American Federation of Government Employees, United Auto Workers Local 31, the SEIU Kansas Local 513 and UFCW Local 2.

Press Release•October 14, 2026100 Kansas Republicans Are Now Backing Cindy Holscher for GovernorToday, the Cindy Holscher for Governor campaign announced that 80 additional current and former Republicans from across Kansas have endorsed Senator Cindy Holscher and joined “Republicans for Cindy,” bringing the coalition to 100 members. They joined the 20 current and former Republican elected officials who launched the coalition, many of whom served alongside both Holscher and Masterson in the legislature.

Press Release•October 16, 2026NEW: Holscher calls out Masterson for no-show job in WichitaDemocratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher held a press conference today outside GoCreate at Wichita State University, calling out Ty Masterson’s million-dollar “no-show job” and the corrupt system that has allowed wealthy special interests to bankroll his career while influencing his work in the Legislature.

Press Release•October 9, 2026Missouri-Kansas-Nebraska Conference of Teamsters Endorses Cindy Holscher for GovernorToday, the Missouri-Kansas-Nebraska Conference of Teamsters endorsed Cindy Holscher for governor, adding to the growing coalition behind her campaign. The Teamsters represent more than 6,000 working men and women across Kansas, in areas as diverse as freight distribution, car-haul, heavy highway construction, wholesale and retail food distribution, small parcel and package delivery, brewery and soda manufacturing, railroad and maintenance of way workers, school bus drivers, and many of Kansas’ transportation industries.

Press Release•September 29, 2026Holscher launches new webisode on data centers with lifelong RepublicansIn a new video today, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher is highlighting the Marple family, who have raised serious concerns about a proposed 10-building data center complex threatening their family farm. The Marples are lifelong Republicans, but they are supporting Cindy Holscher because she’s the only candidate for governor taking data center concerns seriously.

Press Release•September 30, 2026Cindy Holscher Launches New Television Ad Highlighting Need for Firm Guardrails on Data CentersToday, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher launched her newest television ad, “Sunflowers,” highlighting the need for firm guardrails around new data center development in Kansas. The ad will air statewide on broadcast, cable, and digital platforms starting today.
